fieldNotes.location: Roster coord (29.95459,-90.193853, movedMeters 1000) lands on a small tan metal warehouse on a side street — not the PFG DC. PFG's own location page geocodes the New Orleans facility to ~29.95N,-90.19W in the Elmwood/Harahan industrial district. Resolved to the substantial distribution building ~150m SW at ~29.9539,-90.1951 — the only nearby structure with the dock count, blue-banded dock face and trailer drop yard consistent with a broadline foodservice DC. Address 918 Edwards Ave, Harahan LA 70123 (operating entity Reinhart Foodservice Louisiana LLC). Specific PFG signage could not be confirmed in Street View, so confidence is medium.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View of the building's south/SW frontage shows chain-link fencing and a fenced truck-yard entrance with tractors and trailers inside. A gate spans the truck drive. Classed truckGate true; obscured angles leave it uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth structure visible at the entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no shack — kiosk / call-box check-in implied. true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank along the south face of the building (painted blue dock wall) with trailers backed in; ~25-50 doors, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop rows in the lot SE of the building; ~25-50 trailers, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tightly built-out Elmwood industrial parcel — narrow internal streets and little stacking room; a truck queue at the gate would choke the internal street. true.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Elmwood/Harahan metro New Orleans industrial fabric — Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Reads as one large DC building; the dense multi-tenant context makes a precise count low-confidence.
